Source: STMicroelectronics RM0008 reference manual for STM32F101/F102/F103/F105/F107 MCUs.
Public URL: https://www.st.com/resource/en/reference_manual/rm0008-stm32f103xx-advanced-armbased-32bit-mcus-stmicroelectronics.pdf

USART1 base address: 0x4001 3800

USART register map
Register Offset
USART_SR 0x00
USART_DR 0x04
USART_BRR 0x08
USART_CR1 0x0C
USART_CR2 0x10
USART_CR3 0x14
USART_GTPR 0x18
